name: Business Identity
description: Consolidates an organization's business identity (name, contact, address, legal/VAT, opening hours, social links) into a single admin config page, and exposes it through a display block and tokens.
project_description: Objective: Enhance the usability and accessibility of Drupal's administrative interface to meet business client standards by creating a unified configuration page that consolidates all business-related fields representing an enterprise, organization, retail location, or similar entity. Fields on this page originate from three sources: Drupal Core, third-party/custom modules, and custom fields not available elsewhere. The module aims to provide a comprehensive, easily understandable overview of business identity data, and to define and export the business identity of the organization promoted through the Drupal installation. Key benefits for business users: a single-pane view for managing all business identity information, streamlined data management across multiple data sources, professional presentation suitable for corporate environments, export capability for sharing business identity across systems, and intuitive organization that reduces training time for administrative staff. Typical use cases span museums and cultural institutions, hotels and hospitality, retail and shops, parks and public spaces, and organizations and offices. Country-specific legal fields (VAT identifiers, register numbers, GDPR/privacy compliance, e-invoicing) are provided by optional local-law submodules such as business_identity_local_de (Germany) and business_identity_local_it (Italy).
